name: SupportCandy

evidence.helpdesk: F02: Self-hosted WordPress ticketing and customer portal; F17: Pro email piping creates tickets from email
evidence.ai: F22: Free chatbot answers visitors from trained content and offers a ticket for human follow-up
evidence.inbox: F18: Free core has assignment, roles, private notes and a viewer indicator showing who is on a ticket

line: WordPress ticketing and customer portal with optional email piping.

free.text: Free core; email piping requires a paid bundle

cells.ai: Bring your own provider API key

agents.math: The one-site annual offer includes email piping (tickets made from incoming email) and unlimited agents.
The same one-site bundle covers three agents. The price is not per user.
